new_product.product_type: 150 g olive-oil-and-sea-salt infused Greek yogurt; directional savory recipe concept pending emulsion, seasoning and serving-context validation
new_product.lineup_role: Savory and meal-adjacent endpoint — extends the family beyond breakfast, snack and small dessert moments while preserving the same ready-to-open, spoonable 150 g cup.
new_product.use_case: A small savory cup beside a light lunch, eaten directly with a spoon or paired with a simple bread or vegetable serving only after R&D and user testing confirm the clearest context; it is not positioned as a meal replacement.
new_product.differentiator: A thin translucent olive-gold oil ribbon, a pearly micro-emulsion trace inside the spoon cut and sparse fine salt crystals create a savory material signal distinct from Fig Leaf's muted sage veil and from the other products' flecks, peel threads or dark marble.

package: The same warm-ivory, matte, low-wide 150 g cup and large peel tab used by the family.

One narrow muted olive-gold / mineral-straw identifier field, directionally #A18A57 pending food-color and print tests; it must not shift toward Fig Leaf's sage green (#68765F in the current directional map).
Two very small warm-white salt points may sit inside the identifier field as a functional recipe locator; they are not repeated as decoration across the pack.
The ingredient color is limited to the identifier field, comparison legend and recipe locator; it does not tint the full cup, background, typography, light or photography set.
edible_product: Dense ivory Greek yogurt with the same deep spoon furrow and standing soft ridge as the family.
One thin, translucent olive-gold ribbon folded across part of the surface and continuing visibly into the spoon cut; no deep green tint and no pooled oil lake.
A narrow pearly emulsion halo and a few fine oil microdroplets at the ribbon edge show that oil meets the yogurt rather than sitting only as a top garnish.

Sparse, fine, irregular salt crystals remain visible on one ridge and at one spoon-cut edge only if the validated recipe actually retains them at serving; crystals must not be enlarged, multiplied or replaced with decorative flakes for photography.
If validated salt dissolves completely, salt proof moves to an R&D-approved measured seasoning action and factual ingredient disclosure rather than fabricated visible crystals.
form_cues.use_signal: A 45-degree open-cup frame keeps the full cup and peel-back lid visible while one spoon crosses the oil ribbon; a single modest bread or vegetable element may enter the far edge only after serving-context validation, never becoming a styled meal spread.
form_cues.ingredient_infusion_signal: A macro pair shows the translucent oil ribbon and pearly micro-emulsion continuing through the yogurt mass, plus an actual-scale salt cue on the ridge or a validated measured-salt action when crystals are not truthfully visible.
form_cues.color_function_boundary: Olive-gold identifies the oil-led recipe and connects closed pack to edible oil color. It is not a premium metallic, grade cue, origin cue, health cue or ambient brand accent.
form_cues.distinct_from_fig_leaf: Fig Leaf remains desaturated sage and nearly ivory in the food; Olive Oil & Sea Salt uses a warmer, yellower mineral-straw identifier and a translucent ribbon/emulsion/crystal food pattern, never a green leaf veil.

new_product.allowed_variation: The oil ribbon may move from one thin crescent to two short broken threads when validated stability naturally changes its path; cup form, identifier field, emulsion proof and truthful salt cue remain fixed.
new_product.product_usp: 얇은 올리브 오일 리본과 소금의 짧은 대비를 되직한 요거트 안에 겹쳐, 같은 한 컵 구조를 식사 곁의 세이보리 순간까지 넓히는 라인업의 여섯 번째 끝점.
new_product.landing_message: 올리브 오일의 얇은 결과 소금의 짧은 대비. 한 컵이 식사 곁으로 갑니다.

image_roles.brief: 45도 열린 컵, 깊은 스푼 자국, 오일 리본을 가로질러 들어 올린 한 숟갈을 중심에 둔다. 검증된 경우에만 프레임 가장자리에 단순한 bread 또는 vegetable cue 하나를 두어 meal-adjacent임을 설명하고, 완성 식사나 meal-replacement 장면은 만들지 않는다.
표면의 얇은 translucent ribbon이 숟갈 단면 안쪽의 pearly emulsion halo와 microdroplets로 이어지는 실제 R&D 샘플 근접 증거. 기름 웅덩이, 합성 광택, green color cast는 금지한다.
실제 레시피에 남는 미세 salt crystal을 컵 가장자리 또는 spoon tip과 함께 실제 크기로 보여 준다. 완전 용해형이면 정량 수치를 주장하지 않는 measured seasoning action으로 대체하고 가짜 결정은 만들지 않는다.
닫힌 미색 컵의 좁은 olive-gold identifier와 열린 컵의 실제 translucent oil ribbon을 나란히 놓아 색이 장식이 아니라 내용물 locator임을 증명한다.
같은 각도와 spoon cut에서 Thyme Honey ribbon/fleck, Fig Leaf veil, Roasted Buckwheat fleck, Citrus Peel thread, Black Sesame marble, Olive Oil & Sea Salt emulsion/crystal의 차이를 비교한다.

minimal_family_updates.change_principle: Keep the existing four landing features, five shared invariants, four cognitive invariants, cup architecture and Thyme Honey hero. Replace only five-product language and extend the food-pattern and use-context logic enough to admit one savory endpoint.

one_line_definition.from: 천연 재료의 향·색·입자·여운을 되직한 그릭요거트 한 컵 안에 겹쳐 보여 주는 150 g 인퓨전 요거트 다섯 종.
one_line_definition.to: 천연 재료의 향·색·입자·여운을 되직한 그릭요거트 한 컵 안에 겹쳐 보여 주며, 아침과 간식·작은 디저트에서 식사 곁의 세이보리 순간까지 이어지는 150 g 인퓨전 요거트 여섯 종.

shared_architecture.from: 150 g 낮고 넓은 1회용 컵을 고정하고, 각 레시피는 하나의 주재료 조합, 하나의 감각 방향, 하나의 대표 사용 순간, 하나의 식용 표면 패턴으로 구분한다. 랜딩에서는 모든 제품을 closed pack, open cup, spoon cut의 같은 세 상태로 반복한다.
shared_architecture.to: 150 g 낮고 넓은 1회용 컵을 고정하고, 각 레시피는 하나의 주재료 조합, 하나의 감각 방향, 하나의 대표 사용 순간, 하나의 식용 표면 패턴으로 구분한다. 다섯 제품이 아침·간식·작은 디저트 안에서 차이를 만들고 Olive Oil & Sea Salt가 동일 구조를 식사 곁의 세이보리 순간까지 확장한다. 랜딩에서는 여섯 제품 모두를 closed pack, open cup, spoon cut의 같은 세 상태로 반복한다.

shared_invariants.replacement: 모든 제품은 토핑을 위에 쌓지 않고 색 번짐, 얇은 리본, 미세 입자, 필 스레드, 마블링, 유화 흔적 또는 검증된 미세 결정 중 하나가 요거트 안쪽까지 이어져 인퓨전 방향을 드러낸다. 소금이 완전히 녹는 레시피에서는 가시 결정을 꾸미지 않고 검증된 재료 행동과 정보로 증명한다.

cognitive_invariants.replacement: 여섯 제품은 같은 정보 순서와 같은 촬영 상태로 비교되어 차이가 용기 장식이 아니라 veil, fleck, thread, marble, ribbon/emulsion/crystal 같은 실제 재료 흔적과 대표 사용 순간에서 발생함을 보여 준다.

fixed.value: 컵 비례, 필 탭, 정보 순서, 미색 바탕, 스푼 자국, 촬영 각도

variable.value: 한 가지 기능적 재료 식별색, 식용 표면 패턴, 감각 단어, 대표 섭취 순간

decision_rule.value: 색은 포장 장식이 아니라 실제 내용물 예고에만 쓰며, 각 제품은 다른 식용 패턴을 가져 여섯 종을 흑백으로 보아도 veil, fleck, thread, marble, ribbon/emulsion/crystal의 차이로 구분되어야 한다. Olive Oil & Sea Salt의 olive-gold는 좁은 locator에만 쓰고 Fig Leaf의 sage-green과 음식 흔적 양쪽에서 분리한다.

hero_logic.value: Thyme Honey가 '익숙한 단맛 + 낯선 허브 흔적'으로 가족의 개념을 가장 빠르게 설명하고, Fig Leaf, Roasted Buckwheat, Citrus Peel, Black Sesame가 green, toasted, bright, deep 방향을 확장한다. Olive Oil & Sea Salt는 translucent oil ribbon, emulsion and truthful salt cue로 savory / meal-adjacent endpoint를 맡는다.

replacement.name: 여섯 가지 감각 좌표
replacement.message: herbal, green, toasted, bright, deep, savory의 서로 다른 선택 이유를 동일한 정보 순서로 비교하고, Olive Oil & Sea Salt만 식사 곁의 meal-adjacent 순간을 연다.
replacement.proof: 같은 각도·같은 양·같은 스푼 동작으로 촬영한 6종 비교와 savory serving-context 한 장

resulting_value.communication_job: 낮고 넓은 150 g 컵, 깊은 spoon furrow, 들어 올린 한 숟갈, honey ribbon과 thyme fleck를 한 장에 보여 제품 정의를 즉시 이해시킨다.
동일한 컵과 정보 구조 속에서 실제 재료색 한 영역만 바뀌는 여섯 제품 가족 구조를 증명하며, Fig Leaf sage와 Olive Oil & Sea Salt olive-gold가 명확히 분리되어야 한다.
동일 각도와 동일 spoon cut으로 ribbon/fleck, veil, grain fleck, peel thread, dark marble, oil emulsion/crystal의 차이를 비교한다.
각 제품에서 재료 흔적이 표면이 아니라 숟갈 단면 안쪽까지 이어짐을 macro로 증명하고, Olive Oil & Sea Salt는 실제 oil/emulsion과 truthful salt cue를 함께 보여 준다.
closed cup → peel → scoop 세 상태로 150 g 한 컵의 실제 사용을 설명한다.
컵을 주역으로 유지한 채 검증된 단일 serving cue만 더해 snack/dessert family가 meal-adjacent endpoint까지 확장됨을 보여 주고, meal replacement나 건강 식단을 암시하지 않는다.

necessary_product_visual_map_entry.identifier_color: #A18A57 directional muted olive-gold / mineral-straw; print and food-match validation required
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.color_use: narrow identifier field, comparison legend and recipe locator only
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.color_exclusions: not full-pack color, ambient light, set color, metallic premium cue, grade cue or origin cue
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.distinct_from_fig_leaf: warmer and yellower than Fig Leaf #68765F sage; never leaf-green
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.food_truth_to_verify: oil ribbon path, emulsion stability, separation behavior, salt dissolution/crystal visibility and the actual serving state
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.hero_trace: thin translucent olive-gold ribbon, narrow pearly emulsion halo, actual-scale salt cue only when present in the validated recipe
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.primary_image_job: explain the savory meal-adjacent endpoint without changing the shared yogurt cup architecture
necessary_product_visual_map_entry.use_moment: light-lunch side or direct savory spooning, pending serving-context validation

questions: Does the intended olive-oil inclusion remain as a thin readable ribbon plus micro-emulsion at serving temperature, or does it pool, soak into the lid, migrate to the cup wall or read as greasy separation?
How do mixing order, droplet size, holding time, transport vibration and temperature change the visible ribbon and spoon-cut trace?
Can the photographed hero state be reproduced by the actual product without styling oil added only for camera?
r_and_d_checks.acceptance_boundary: Lock the ribbon/emulsion visual only after an actual stable R&D sample produces it. If pooling is intrinsic, revise the form cue rather than hiding separation in retouching.

questions: What salt level supports the intended savory contrast without making a quantified nutrition or better-for-you claim?
Does the selected salt particle size dissolve fully, remain as a few perceptible crystals or create uneven bites during the expected serving window?
Does any visible crystal in photography match the actual formulation, size and distribution rather than a camera-only garnish?
r_and_d_checks.acceptance_boundary: Do not specify a grade, origin or proprietary salt story. Do not enlarge crystals or increase their count for visibility; use measured ingredient action and factual disclosure when salt is not visually present.

questions: Do users understand the product as a spoonable savory yogurt cup, a meal-side accompaniment or a dip, and which one context should the landing page lead with?
Which single modest serving cue — direct spoon, plain bread or vegetable — clarifies use without turning the image into a recipe, full meal or meal-replacement claim?
Does adding a meal-adjacent endpoint strengthen the six-product choice system without confusing the existing breakfast, snack and dessert roles?
r_and_d_checks.acceptance_boundary: Choose one leading context only after user and sensory testing. Until then, retain 'meal-adjacent directional concept' and avoid prescriptive meal, health or nutrition language.

claim_and_trade_dress_boundaries: Do not claim olive-oil grade, cultivar, harvest, cold pressing, region, origin, traceability, antioxidant content or other unverified quality markers.
Do not claim salt grade, mineral profile, region, health benefit, reduced sodium or precise level before formulation and legal validation.
Do not imply probiotic, high-protein, low-sugar, digestive, medical, sustainability, recycling or meal-replacement benefits.

Keep MORA's food-native low-wide cup, broad matte ivory field and function-only ingredient locator; do not introduce Le Labo labels, name-plus-number architecture, perfume vessels, individualized production labels or laboratory trade dress.
